title: Composer jumps on iOS Safari
description: Fix the iOS Safari bug where the virtual keyboard covers the chat composer. ## Repro Matrix | Device | OS | Result | | --- | --- | --- | | iPhone 15 Pro | iOS 17 | Composer visible | | iPhone SE | iOS 17 | 40px gap on rotate | | Android Chrome | 14 | No regression | ## Implementation Sketch Listen to visualViewport.resize and pin the composer above the keyboard. ~~~ts const offset = window.innerHeight - visualViewport.height - visualViewport.offsetTop; composer.style.setProperty('--keyboard-offset', String(offset) + 'px'); ~~~ ## Must Verify - [ ] VoiceOver focus order - [ ] Rotation while typing - [ ] Long streaming response while keyboard is open - [ ] No conflict with **BUG-104** autoscroll changes

discussions.text: Repro confirmed on iOS Safari: the virtual keyboard resizes the layout viewport and covers the composer. Fix: pin the composer with a visualViewport.resize listener. Verify against TalkBack and VoiceOver before closing.
